extension.description: Hosts the Letterboxd and Premiumize Downloader add-ons and pushes their updates automatically.

extension.summary: Browse your Letterboxd account in Kodi
extension.description: Browse your Letterboxd watchlist, diary, and custom lists directly inside Kodi. Works with just a username (via RSS) or with an official API key for richer data and private lists.
extension.disclaimer: A Letterboxd account is required. API credentials are optional but enable private list access and password-based login.

extension.summary: Download your premiumize.me and Real-Debrid files at full speed and play them locally
extension.description: Browse your premiumize.me cloud and Real-Debrid torrents, download videos over several parallel connections, start watching while they download, and play them from local or USB storage. Downloads resume after restarts, and subtitles next to a video come along with it.
extension.disclaimer: Needs a premiumize.me or Real-Debrid account. Not made by or affiliated with either service.
extension.news: 1.1.2: Real-Debrid downloads no longer keep dropping and stalling. Real-Debrid closes every connection after one request and resets new ones that come too fast; the add-on now notices that and asks for long pieces (about 16 MB instead of 4 MB). Measured on a real account: no resets at a steady 28-32 MB/s, where before there were 86 resets in 45 seconds and stalls. Single-file Real-Debrid torrents show as playable files again (the list now asks for 100 torrents at a time; above that Real-Debrid leaves out their links). 1.1.1: Fixes "Real-Debrid torrents" showing an empty list: Real-Debrid returns nothing for the way 1.1.0 asked for the list. Checked on a real account. 1.1.0: Real-Debrid support, and the add-on is now called Debrid Downloader. Sign in with a code from the main menu ("Add Real-Debrid"), then "Real-Debrid torrents" lists your torrents: download, play while downloading, stream, speed test and delete work as they do for premiumize. Search looks in both. premiumize settings and downloads are unchanged. 1.0.14: Storage in the main menu: a gauge of how full the download drive is and how much is free. Select it for details (folder, total, space taken by your downloads) or to change the folder. 1.0.13: "Delete from premiumize cloud" in the long-press menu of cloud files and folders. Asks first, keeps copies already downloaded, and cancels unfinished downloads of what is deleted. 1.0.12: A finished download whose file was deleted counts as not downloaded: selecting it asks again (Play now / Download / Stream) instead of quietly downloading the whole file again. 1.0.11: Playback gets a clean title, year and type read from the release name (movie "Ran" (1985), or show, season and episode), so the Trakt add-on can scrobble downloads and Play now. Finished files in Downloads play through the add-on for the same reason. 1.0.10: If a download slows to under half its best speed for 45 seconds with no visible reason, it gets a fresh link from premiumize and reconnects, as a manual restart would. The progress window shows drive speed, data waiting to be saved and reconnects. 1.0.9: The speed test pauses running downloads during the test (and resumes them after), so they no longer skew its numbers. 1.0.8: Shorter file names in the progress window, so long release names no longer hide the reason line. 1.0.7: Settings > Downloads > Test drive speed: writes a test file for about 30 seconds and shows how fast the download drive really saves data (average and longest pause). 1.0.6: Optional speed limit (Settings > Downloads) for networks that struggle at full speed. The progress window keeps long names to one line so the reason line stays visible, and shows a steady connection count with how many are retrying. 1.0.5: Speed test advice keeps at least 4 connections (so a slow one can be replaced) and says when your line is the limit. 1.0.4: Fixes downloads freezing at 0 speed when one connection slowed to a crawl: an idle connection now takes over the slow piece. Shows why a download is slow or waiting (drive speed, connection limits, retries) in the progress window, the corner bar and Downloads. A drive write that hangs now stops the download with a clear message. 1.0.3: When no USB drive is visible, explains that a drive set up as "device storage" must be formatted as removable storage. 1.0.2: "Choose download folder..." now lists USB drives found directly on the device (Kodi's own folder browser often misses them on the Shield), shows free space and size, and accepts a typed path. 1.0.1: Selecting a cloud video now shows the Play now / Download only / Stream choice as a normal list before playback starts (it could be invisible before). Corrected the Shield permission path in messages. 1.0.0: first release
